infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: OneHelp needs your location to send your coordinates in emergency SOS alerts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: OneHelp needs background location to broadcast rescue coordinates during active SOS even when the screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OneHelp uses the microphone for hands-free voice trigger SOS detection and emergency audio evidence recording.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: OneHelp uses the camera for scanning emergency QR medical dossiers and hazard photo evidence.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: OneHelp uses Bluetooth Low Energy to relay SOS alerts when there is zero cellular and Wi-Fi connectivity.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow OneHelp to use your location for emergency dispatch.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow OneHelp to use your camera for emergency evidence and QR code scanning.
